recipe.title: Quick Pan-Seared Lemon Herb Chicken with Garlic Butter Rice
recipe.description: Tender, juicy pan-seared chicken cutlets served over fragrant garlic-infused jasmine rice with a silky lemon pan sauce.

ingredients.item: Boneless, skinless chicken breasts (cut into thin cutlets)
Salt and freshly cracked black pepper

instructions.text: Season the chicken cutlets generously on both sides with salt and black pepper.
Heat olive oil and 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add chicken cutlets and sear for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through (internal temperature of 165°F). Transfer chicken to a plate to rest.
Reduce heat to medium, add minced garlic to the same skillet, and sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in chicken broth and lemon juice, using a wooden spoon to scrape up any browned bits from the skillet. Simmer for 2 minutes.
Stir in the pre-cooked Jasmine rice and the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter, tossing constantly for 2 minutes until hot and well coated.
Slice chicken thinly, divide garlic rice between two plates, top with sliced chicken, and finish with a sprinkle of fresh parsley.

tips: Slice chicken breasts horizontally into cutlets or pound them to 1/2-inch thickness so they cook thoroughly in under 8 minutes.
Using microwaveable pouch rice or leftover chilled cooked rice saves precious time while maintaining perfect texture.
